description.value: The Old Spaghetti Factory is a 100% Canadian-owned chain Italian restaurant with a New Westminster location on Eighth Street, offering multi-course pasta meals made with locally-sourced ingredients where possible. The restaurant is a full-service sit-down establishment with indoor seating and no outdoor patio. It is one of 15 locations across Canada and can accommodate a range of dietary needs including gluten-free, vegan, and allergen requests.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 72m; rack at 85m; stands (2 spaces) at 86m; rack at 97m. Total: 4 spaces.
